newsitem.title: UK: Gazprom plans Eurobond of up to $500 mln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom plans Eurobond of up to $500 mln - paper.

text.p: Gas giant Gazprom is set to become the first Russian company to tap the Eurobond market since the collapse of the Soviet Union, with plans for an issue of up to $500 million, the Financial Times said on Friday.

The report said Gazprom, which received $429.3 million in October from an international share offer, is set to raise between $250 million and $500 million to finance new investments to buttress its position in the European market.
The move, if it goes ahead, could trigger a rash of other issues from fellow Russian companies, the FT said.
Gazprom's issue is expected to follow soon after the Russian sovereign bond issue planned for this month.
